findings.title: Open port 21/tcp: ftp vsftpd 3.0.5
Anonymous FTP allowed (21/tcp)
findings.detail: Anyone can read the published files without a password. Check that this is intended and that there is no confidential data (in vsftpd: anonymous_enable=NO). The file list cannot be read from here (PASV failed: 550 Permission denied.), so it is NOT possible to tell whether there are writable directories: the ftp check verifies it from the inside.
